subject: Quick fence repair check
text:
Hi all, I think I got my wires crossed about the shared fence repair request. When I mentioned the loose panel, I only meant checking whether one board was out, not that the whole side needs replacing yet. The job still isn't finished, and I wanted to make sure no one spends a whole Saturday digging in the dirt because of my messy wording. Could someone pop by for ten minutes before the weekend to see if the corner post just needs tightening? I can help move tools, grab coffee, or stay out of the way while you look. If it does, I'll bring the brace I already picked up.
Cheers,
